title: How to play · 1 of 2
intro: A bar balances when weight × notches is the same on both sides. Hang the 1 and the 2 so this bar is level.
outro: 1 × 2 = 2 × 1. Light weights go far out, heavy weights stay close in.

title: How to play · 2 of 2
intro: A bar carries everything hanging below it. Balance the small bar first, then the top one.
outro: The small bar holds 2 + 1 = 3, which balances the 3 on the other side. You're ready!
